messages.author: 1c8682eea45d1330
messages.subject: sleeplog example
parts:
Hi, I've just started using GGIR to assess sleep with the Axivity AX3 datalogger. Through trial and error I have gotten most of the GGRI shell script to run using R/Rstudio. However, I keep getting error messages when I use my csv-formatted sleep log to guide lights-out/on. I've tried to adhere to the formatting of the csv-file as described in the GGIR documentation, but so far unsuccesfully. My question to this forum is, if anyone has a sleep log from their own analyses that work and would be willing to share such a file with me? I could the use this template to insert my own lights-off/on timestamps and hopefully get it to run in GGIR.

Best regards, Morten

I have used the same sleeplog template as well and created a folder for it to be accessed by GGIR but the following error occurred:

Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
cannot open file 'C:/Users/khc745/Documents/log': Permission denied

Does anyone know what could the error be and the solution for that?

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: sleeplog example
parts:
Hi John,
It is trying to read "'C:/Users/khc745/Documents/log", which does not look like a csv-file.

Are specifying the actual csv file in your input or a folder name? You need to specify the actual file, which might be something like "'C:/Users/khc745/Documents/log/mysleeplog.csv"
Can you read the sleeplog csv file with R function read.csv? => If yes, can you use GGIR function g.loadlog? => If yes, then g.shell.GGIR should also be able to handle it?

Best, Vincent
